WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory, cp.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND (cp.category = 'Garden' OR p.category='Garden')
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT r.sales_line_id, SUM(r.refund_net) refund_net, count(*) n FROM fact_return_line r GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.category, s.subcategory, count(*) lines, count(r.sales_line_id) returned_lines,
       SUM(s.net_amount) sold_net, SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0)) refund_net,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(COALESCE(r.refund_net,0))/SUM(s.net_amount),2) rate
FROM sold s LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = s.sales_line_id
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH j AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, f.sale_date, r.return_line_id, r.refund_net, r.quantity_returned, r.return_date, r.reason_code
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
 JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1
)
SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN refund_net > net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) refund_gt_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN quantity_returned > quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) qty_gt,
  sum(CASE WHEN return_date < sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) before_sale,
  sum(CASE WHEN return_date > sale_date + 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over30,
  sum(CASE WHEN refund_net <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
  max(return_date) maxret, count(DISTINCT reason_code) reasons
FROM j
